answer: The price of trying is 25 stamped dockets, each costing £12 to have checked, paid up front for every single name, while the pigment stays small. No Spicebound milkman salt bond, no seat: the rule is plain, and a bond milkmen lodge after dairy inspections is why it holds. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The tide is checked, not assumed. The terrace is on the docket.
